description: National Risk Index States Expected Annual Loss is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by FEMA AGOL. National Risk Index Data Version: December 2025 (1.20.0) The National Risk Index States Expected Annual Loss feature layer contains state-level data for Expected Annual Loss. County-level Expected Annual Loss data were aggregated to produce this state-level dataset. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of FEMA AGOL. Its keywords are State, Feature Layer, Feature, Query, National Risk Index, NRI, The National Risk Index, The NRI. The bounding box given is -179.1473,-14.3738,179.7784,71.3613. The hub shows 2025-12-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (Terms & Conditions FEMA offers some of its public data in machine readable format via an Application Programming Interfa ...); terms not read in full. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
